verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS connectivity platform that holds tailnet policy, device, and user data, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented feature for exporting account or tailnet data in open formats. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: infrastructure-as-code automation, the policy file editor, and a community note that most clients support a custom control server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
